channel.title: Comments on: Nature’s Bell Curve
channel.description: taoism, taoist thought, buddha, yoga, tai chi, shakuhachi

item.title: By: Carl Abbott
item.dc:creator: Carl Abbott
item.description:
Yes, and I find that seeing "things happen" in terms of the Bell Curve seems to help me "accept them unconditionally". Once I deeply understand nature's process, I find it impossible to "object to them and suffer".
It all hinges on understanding... or as Buddha put it, Right Comprehension. I suppose in the path to Right Comprehension, the devil is in the details. Obviously, mere platitudes can't serve.

item.title: By: Dian
item.dc:creator: Dian
item.description: I'm right there with you, Carl. The way I see it is that "things happen" (the universe unfolding) and then we can either accept them unconditionally, or we can object to them and suffer.
